title: Ambee Pollen High Count Day
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ambee:pollen
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(overall_index) as pollen_index by location _time
| where pollen_index>4
| sort - pollen_index
description: Uses Ambee pollen feeds telemetry to monitor days when the local pollen index becomes meaningfully high in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for allergy-heavy days that affect outdoor plans, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Ambee pollen feeds data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors days when the local pollen index becomes meaningfully high so you can spot allergy-heavy days that affect outdoor plans before it becomes annoying.
